headline: A calm pre-market after a volatile week: S&P 500 futures +0.1% and Nasdaq-100 futures −0.2% as Tesla gains on its Roadster reveal while neocloud and memory names (CoreWeave, IREN, SK hynix, Sandisk) slip again.
notes: Scheduled run at ~7:49 a.m. CT, before the 8:30 a.m. CT open: PRE-MARKET. All movers use live pre-market data dated Oct 16 (StockAnalysis and Yahoo via the Mac browser); StockAnalysis's movers pages were checked to be dated Oct 16.

Gap % = pre-market price vs Thursday's close (StockAnalysis). Quality movers were screened from Yahoo's US list of stocks ≥$5 and ≥$2B (top 3,000 by market cap; 782 had an Oct 16 pre-market quote) and confirmed on StockAnalysis. Yahoo returned pre-market quotes only for names down to ~$5.7B market cap, so $2–5.7B names may be under-represented; StockAnalysis's top-20 movers lists were used to check that gap.

Thin names left out of the movers tables (<10K pre-market shares): PRAX (+2.7%, 699 shares), TS (+2.5%), CP (+2.2%, 253), BEP (+2.5%, 115), PSO, JBHT (−2.2%, 781), ENTG (−2.6%, 3.9K), MTB (−1.2%, 4.8K).
Relative volume = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average full-day volume (Yahoo), so values are naturally small before the open.

Gap watchlist applied strictly: only ZETA (Goldman upgrade) and MBLY (Citi initiation) pass all rules. TSLA (+3.1%) is excluded because the Roadster reveal is a product event, not a listed catalyst type; NFLX (−3.6%, content-chief change) and MSTR (−3.4%, MSCI index-eligibility rules) likewise. FOX/FOXA (BofA double upgrade) and SMTC (raised guidance, Northland upgrade) have listed catalysts but under 100K pre-market shares.

TLK (−14.8%, 498K shares) has no identifiable news in Yahoo, Benzinga or web search; a Seeking Alpha piece mentions an infrastructure-unit spinoff, so the drop could be a distribution-related price adjustment — not verified. Excluded from the watchlist; kept in the losers table with that caveat.

JAGX (+39–49% on StockAnalysis) is left out of the under-$5 table: StockAnalysis's prior close ($2.295) is adjusted for a special stock dividend, while Yahoo's unadjusted close is $4.59; on an unadjusted basis it is lower pre-market (MT Newswires lists it among top decliners). Treated as an adjustment artifact.

Bank earnings reactions are thin and sources disagree: Benzinga (~7:02 a.m. CT) had TFC −2.5% and RF −2.0%; StockAnalysis (~7:44–7:52 a.m. CT, ~10–12K shares) had TFC +0.3% and RF +0.2%. CFG: StockAnalysis −1.9% (11K shares) vs Investing.com 'over 5%'. Ranges are shown in the earnings table.
WTI is Yahoo's CL=F front month ($95.75); AP cited U.S. crude at $97.77, likely a different contract month. Bitcoin change is Yahoo's 24-hour figure.

Economic calendar is light: September industrial production at 8:15 a.m. CT (Fed release; consensus +0.4% from Thursday's Trading Economics read, not re-checked). No other Fed speaker times were confirmed for today.

Under-$5 lists are StockAnalysis's top-20 pre-market gainers and losers (~7:50 a.m. CT), filtered to ≥100K shares and <$5. Market cap is StockAnalysis's figure. Float was not available from Yahoo (n/a). Reverse splits were checked only via news headlines (GP announced a share consolidation).
drivers: Futures are little changed after a week of hot inflation data and an AI/chip sell-off: S&P 500 futures +0.1%, Nasdaq-100 futures −0.2%, with the 10-year yield steady near 5.09% after this week's spike to ~5.3%. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, speaking at the IMF/World Bank meetings in Bangkok, called AI the most consequential economic change of his lifetime but declined to pre-judge the Oct 27–28 FOMC; futures price roughly 15% odds of an October hike after September's increase. Asia rebounded from Thursday's rout (Nikkei +1.4%, KOSPI +2.1%, Hang Seng +0.5%) and the DAX is up ~1%. In single names, Tesla is up ~3% on its redesigned Roadster reveal, while CoreWeave, IREN and Nebius extend losses on neocloud debt-cost worries and Netflix slips after replacing its content chief. Brent stays above $106 with no U.S.–Iran deal; regional banks (Truist, Regions, Citizens, M&T) and Travelers reported before the open with mostly EPS beats but soft revenue.
